learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 179 products on 15 Webflow pages of 12 (page 16 is empty). No sitemap, no JSON; product pages add nothing but a 'More <Category>' block and, for BagelHole, a description. 2026-10-08, curation pass: pack sizes rewritten as 'N x unit' (a catalog label 'Npk total' now reads back as written, so '4pk 0.75g' had become a 0.75g total); size-less badders read at 1g; store_aliases added. 2026-10-08 (wave 3, curation of the remaining leads): no rule change; notes added on Two-Fer 1g store names, the MF-er gummy labels, the live rosin badders stores fold into resin products, and the line-less store-only Live Resin products.
notes: body is the card image's URL, not a description: its file name ('MFNY%20Live%20Resin%20510%20Vape%20Cart%20Honey%20Banana%20.5g.png') is the only place the site states most sizes. About a third of the images are bare 'image.png'.

Sizes, in order: a size in the title, then one in the image name, then a format constant where every sized image and the stores agree: 510 carts 0.5g (the 1g carts say 1g in the title), non-Classics Vape Pens 0.5g, Classics AIOs 1g (UK Cheese's title; stores sell Sour Diesel at 1g only), Mini Pre-Rolls 0.75g and their Four Packs 4 x 0.75g, Two-Fers 2 x 0.5g, gummies 10 x 10mg, BagelHole 2g flower + 0.5g extract (its product page).

Skipped on purpose because the site never states the size: tinctures (images say 15ml; stores list lab totals from 391mg to 1000mg), the intimacy oil, badders/concentrates with neither a titled nor an imaged size (stores sell MFNY badder at 1g and 2g), and the older plain 'Pre-Roll' singles (not Mini; no size anywhere, and stores carry none of them).

A Four Pack is sometimes only in the image name ('... .75g Four Pack.png' under a title without it); the image decides then. A Mini Pre-Rolls title with a bare image is read as a single, as the brand titles its Four Packs; 'Blueberry 2.0 x Turbo Blueberry Resin Mini Pre-Rolls' may really be the 4-pack stores sell.

Line is the extract (Live Resin / Live Rosin), with 'Classics' in front for that line; Two-Fer packs get line 'Two-Fer' so a 2 x 0.5g pack is not the same product as a 1g cart. Pre-rolls and gummies have no line but Classics and BagelHole: every MFNY pre-roll is resin-infused, and titles say 'Resin' only sometimes.
A leading 'MFNY' is dropped from single-strain names ('MFNY Skunk' -> 'Skunk'), as stores write them. Titles carry typos ('Gumies', 'Mii Pre-Rolls', double spaces) that the patterns absorb.
Category comes from the title's format word; the all-products cards carry no category. 'Mango x Honey Banana' has no format word and gets edible from its image name.

Check on 2026-10-05: 135 entries (the site lists five products twice), stores sell 91 products, 48 found. Of the 43 store-only: 12 are products skipped above for want of a size, 23 are not on the site (Sleepy MF-er, Pina Colada, Super Lemon Haze, White Fire OG pre-rolls, the Belafonte Two-Fer...), and 7 are store spellings the matcher misses: stores write the site's 'Hash Burger x Hash Burger' as 'Hash Burger' (also Candy Rain, Gelonade, Honey Banana, Sour Diesel pre-rolls) and some put Candy Rain rosin under a 'Riverway' line.

Pack sizes are written '4 x 0.75g' and '2 x 0.5g' (count x unit). Since sizes.py reads a catalog label back as written (2026-10-05), '4pk 0.75g' means a 0.75g pack, which collapsed every Four Pack into its single and made Two-Fers 0.5g.

Every MFNY badder or concentrate whose title or image states a size says 1g (18 of them; Classics UK Cheese and Superboof in the title), so a size-less badder reads 1g. Stores also sell 2g jars (Sour Diesel, Skunk, Candy Rain, Chemdog, Lemon Cane, Belafonte); those join the site product as its 2g. A badder title without an extract word is live resin (MFNY: all non-flower products are live resin or rosin; stores write 'Live Resin Badder'), so the line defaults to Live Resin and the subtype to resin. 'Oishii Badder' is the site's second card for Oishii #4 (its page names cultivar 'Oishii #4').

A Vape Pen title without 'Live Resin' (Honey Banana, Rainbow Beltz 2.0, White Fire) is the same 0.5g Live Resin pen; its line is Live Resin. Stores also sell a 1g Live Resin All-in-One (AVD hardware; package 'riverway Live Resin All-in-One Vape ... Contains 1g'), which joins the pen as its 1g.

The Classics green apple gummy prints 'Sour Green Apple x Sour Diesel' on the package, as nine stores write it; the site title shortens it to 'Green Apple'. Every gummy pack also prints an effect label on its side (Focused MF-er, Sleepy MF-er, Mellow MF-er); it is not a line.

store_aliases: 'Riverway' is MFNY's trademark for its extracts (riverway Live Resin / Live Rosin on every package); stores that write 'Riverway Live Rosin Badder' mean the site's Live Rosin badder. 'White Fire OG' is the stores' name for the site's White Fire (site pages give cultivar 'White Fire').

Two-Fer vs 1g: MFNY sells both a 1g single 510 cart ('MFNY's one-gram vape carts ... partnership with ACTIVE'; on the site only Honey Banana and Hash Burger '1g 510 Cart'; stores also sell Candy Rain, Blueberry 2.0 and The Belafonte 1g singles) and the Two-Fer (2 x 0.5g, 1g total). A store's line-less 'X Live Resin 510 Cart | 1g' exact-matches the site's Two-Fer whenever the site has no 1g single of X, and hands it the store names. For Classics Chemdog and Sour Diesel that is right: no 1g single Classics cart exists (site: 0.5g cart + Two-fer only; Weedmaps 'Chemdog | 1g | 2pk Live Resin Cartridges', 'Chemdog Live Resin 510 Cart | .5g 2pk'; store photos on the '1g' listings are the 0.5g bag or the two-cart bag). For main-line strains it can be wrong (Two-Fer Candy Rain holds 'candy rain live resin 510 cart 1g').

Every 510 and badder title says 'Live Resin', Two-Fers included ('Candy Rain Live Resin 510 Cart Two-Fer'), so the line-disagrees lead on Two-Fer products ('store names say Live Resin') is the extract word, not another line.

Gummy packs print an effect label down the side (Sleepy MF-er on Blueberry x Blueberry 2.0, Sexy MF-er on Strawberry Lemonade x Lemon Cane, Mellow MF-er, Focused); the site never uses them and stores write them on 2 of ~100 gummy listings. Not a line: the store-only 'Sleepy MF-er Blueberry x Blueberry 2.0' got its line from one store name, echoed by its matched listings.

Live rosin badders the site does not list (The Belafonte, Hash Burger; one store lists both the resin and the rosin badder of each, at different THC) arrive line-less from the stores and match the site's Live Resin product by strain alone (concentrate subtype does not decide in split_store_products), so their store names land on the resin entry. Not fixable in this recipe.

Store-only vapes and badders arrive without a line (enrichment does not record 'Live Resin' as a line): Strawpaya badder 1g, Super Lemon Haze cart 0.5g and AIO 1g, Superboof AIO 1g. Set their line to Live Resin by admin edit; a recipe rule cannot reach a product the site lacks.
